summary.goal: SQLite storage layer for runs, tasks, attempts, artifacts, gates, questions, and workspaces. Uses JSONB for complex nested data while maintaining queryable columns for status and relationships.

acceptance_criteria.description: runs table with id, plan_ref, status, has_pending_gate, and document JSONB column
tasks table with run_id, step_id, status, dependencies JSONB, workspace_path, gate_id
task_attempts table tracking attempt_number, started_at, ended_at, outcome, error, audit_findings JSONB
artifacts table with type, reference, task_id, created_at
Query helpers: getReadyTasks(runId), getActiveRuns(), getTaskHistory(taskId)
Indexes on status columns for efficient filtering
workspace_cleanup table for retention tracking (task_id, cleanup_after)
gates table for human approval gate state

observations: JSONB pattern from planner-core works well for LLM context assembly
Status columns enable efficient queries without parsing JSON
Task dependencies stored as JSONB array of step_ids
Workspace path tracked for cleanup and debugging
Gates are 1:1 with tasks that have gate config - gate_id on task links them
patterns: Hybrid storage: relational for queries, JSONB for full documents
better-sqlite3 for synchronous operations (matches relay stack)

steps.title: Create SQLite schema definitions
steps.description: Define SQL CREATE TABLE statements for all Forge entities

acceptance_criteria.description: CREATE_RUNS_TABLE: run_id PK, plan_id, plan_version, status (CHECK constraint), has_pending_gate BOOLEAN, document JSONB, started_at, completed_at, error, created_at, updated_at
CREATE_TASKS_TABLE: task_id PK, run_id FK, step_id, status, dependencies JSONB, workspace_path, agent_id, current_attempt, gate_id, created_at, updated_at
CREATE_TASK_ATTEMPTS_TABLE: attempt_id PK, task_id FK, attempt_number, started_at, ended_at, outcome, error, agent_id, audit_findings JSONB
CREATE_ARTIFACTS_TABLE: artifact_id PK, task_id FK, type, reference, metadata JSONB, created_at
CREATE_GATES_TABLE: gate_id PK, task_id FK UNIQUE, status, approver_role, decided_by, decided_at, comment, created_at
CREATE_WORKSPACE_CLEANUP_TABLE: task_id PK, cleanup_after TIMESTAMP
Indexes on status columns for efficient filtering: idx_runs_status, idx_tasks_status, idx_tasks_run_id, idx_gates_status
ALL_SCHEMA_STATEMENTS array for initialization

specification.pattern_description: Copy schema pattern: exported const strings for each CREATE TABLE, CHECK constraints for status enums, indexes for query optimization. See lines 18-65 for table pattern.

acceptance_criteria.description: createForgeStorage(dbPath) factory function returns initialized ForgeStorage
Constructor initializes schema with ALL_SCHEMA_STATEMENTS
Row-to-entity mapping: runFromRow(), taskFromRow(), attemptFromRow(), artifactFromRow(), gateFromRow()
getReadyTasks(runId) returns tasks with status='pending' AND all dependencies completed AND run.has_pending_gate=false
transaction() uses db.transaction() for atomicity
